comments.body:
Game Title: MEKA NEON

Playable Link: [https://studio-krkr.itch.io/mekaneon](https://studio-krkr.itch.io/mekaneon)

Platform: Windows 10/11 (64-bit, downloadable) — please add the appropriate flair after posting

Description: MEKA NEON is a fast-paced neon vector rail shooter set inside a hostile grid. Pilot a vector fighter through a collapsing tunnel, blast waves of enemy ships, weave past obstacles, and chain lock-on missiles to bring down capital ships. Every kill, pickup, and boss takedown feeds the online leaderboard, and the deeper you fly, the faster the grid closes in. The game features a vulcan cannon, lock-on missiles, and a dash maneuver, plus Trident and Lance special weapons and health pickups. Six enemy ship classes and three capital-ship bosses stand between you and a new high score. Built in Rust with a custom Vulkan renderer, MEKA NEON is a love letter to 1980s vector arcade games: hard edges, bright lines, and a synth-driven grid that never stops moving. Keyboard + mouse and gamepad are supported. It runs fullscreen from a single executable, with no installation required.

Free to Play Status: \[x\] Free to play \[ \] Demo/Key available \[ \] Paid (Allowed only on Tuesdays with \[TT\] in the title)

Involvement: I am the solo developer behind MEKA NEON at Devoniak Studios. I handled the design, programming, visuals, and procedural audio, including the custom Rust/Vulkan renderer, the gameplay systems (enemy waves, bosses, weapons, scoring), and the online leaderboard integration. I also built the release package and run the [itch.io](http://itch.io/) page.
